_comment: Copy to <your vault>/vault-graph.json and keep only the keys you change. Every key is optional; the values below are the defaults unless noted. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
_port: Local UI server port (127.0.0.1 only). The VAULT_GRAPH_PORT environment variable overrides it.
_universes: [] = one sky (default). A list such as ["work", "personal"] splits the vault into side-by-side universes, each with its own <universe>/<repos_dir>, <universe>/<global_dir> and board. Order is left to right on the page.
_entity_patterns: Python regexes. Every match becomes an entity star shared by the notes that mention it. Defaults: issue keys like ABC-123, and owner/repo from github.com links.
_auto_memory: `sync` copies Claude Code auto-memory (~/.claude/projects/*/memory/*.md) into the vault. A project folder name like C--Users-alex-code-acme-api becomes code-acme-api, then strip_prefixes turns it into acme-api. map sends it to <repos_dir>/<value>/memory; null skips that project. unmapped: "_inbox" (default), "own" (use the name as the repo folder) or "skip". skip: note names never to import again. Defaults: strip_prefixes [], map {}.
_launcher: Do it in Claude. permission_mode: default | acceptEdits | plan | bypassPermissions. bypassPermissions lets the launched session run every tool without asking; only use it if you accept that. cwd: folder for new sessions (default: the vault). wmux: path to the wmux CLI if it is not found automatically.
_plan_usage: Opt-in. true shows plan limits (5-hour and weekly %) in the top bar, read from an undocumented Anthropic endpoint with your local Claude Code sign-in. See the README before turning it on.
_daily: Commands for `vault.py daily`. The last 10 output lines of each are kept in graph/daily.json, and the prompt hook shows them once a day. Default: [] (off). cmd is a string (run by your shell) or a list (run directly). cwd is relative to the vault unless absolute or ~.
